chapter: Family lore, Boston and Europe with Sam Price
title: Back to New York and the Metropole, about 1956
summary: He returned from Boston about 1956, did gigs at Jack Christy's and went with Red Allen at the Metropole.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: How about after that? That was 1951. What happened after you came back to New York from Boston?
From Boston? I came here and did several gigs. Who did I play with? Did I go with Red Allen, 'cause I stayed with you for a while.
You came from Boston about '55. You stayed in Boston quite a while.
Yes, he was in Boston for quite a while.
Yes, 'cause you were there when my father died, that's how I know, then when my brother died. And then you came here - I think you played at the Metronome - I mean Metropole.
1956. He called me on the job.
I knew he was there quite a while. He was there when my father passed.
After you came back to New York from Boston, what were you doing in New York?
I did a few gigs down to Jack Christy's place, you know.
Second Avenue, Central Plaz a on Second Avenue. He's got a plaque back there that Jack gave him.
I think I went with Red Allen after then.
When you started working in the Metropole?
Yeah, I think that's the way it went.
And like you stayed in the Metropole from about '56 to about how long?
